DHARSHINI SS SENIOR DATA ENGINEER

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

A competent professional with over 8 Years of experience in the IT industry. Expert as a data engineer in creating spark jobs. Seeking to lead a challenging career & to work in an organization where I can contribute my knowledge & skill for the organization's growth, which gives an opportunity for better learning and excellence in the latest technology.

WORK HISTORY

Publicis Sapient - Senior Associate Data Engineering Bengaluru, Karnataka 12/2023 - Current

Architected and implemented a metadata-driven governance framework on GCP using Dataplex, BigQuery, Cloud Data Fusion, Cloud Composer, and Terraform to standardize dataset onboarding across environments. ● Designed reusable ingestion pipelines and automated the deployment of Dataplex aspect types and metadata templates using Infrastructure-as-Code. ● Built a Python-based microservice integrated with CI/CD pipelines to manage

metadata definitions and environment promotions.

Developed modular Cloud Data Fusion pipelines with custom validations (schema checks, header/trailer validation, error handling) to enforce data quality at ingestion.

Orchestrated workflows using Cloud Composer (Airflow), and contributed to

Terraform-based infrastructure automation.

Collaborated with business and data stakeholders to translate governance

and metadata requirements into scalable, technical implementations. ● Authored PySpark jobs for data quality validation, metadata tagging, and

API-based enrichment of BigQuery tables.

Implemented parameterized and modular pipelines to support the

onboarding of new data products with minimal effort.

Worked closely with business teams to translate metadata requirements into

technical artifacts across Dataplex, BigQuery, and CDF.

Altimetrik India - Senior Data Engineer Bengaluru 05/2022 - 11/2023

Architected and implemented an end-to-end data cataloging solution,

improving metadata accuracy and accessibility

Optimized python and scala based Spark jobs to process vast amounts of

data efficiently, reducing processing time and enhancing system performance

Automated ETL workflows using Autosys, ensuring seamless data ingestion,

transformation, and catalog updates

Designed scalable Hive data models, enhancing query performance and

ensuring compatibility with business intelligence tools

● Provided governance and compliance solutions by building metadata lineage

and auditing capabilities within the data catalog

BENGALURU, KARNATAKA 560100 9513355134 dharshupriyacse@hotmail.com WWW: www.linkedin.com/in/dharshinis ureshkumar

SKILLS

Data Fusion ● Apache Airflow

Hive

PySpark

GCP ● Big Query ● Google Big Query ● Apache Spark

Python ● Scala Spark ● Autosys

SQL Java

EDUCATION

04/2016 Sri Ramakrishna Engineering College Coimbatore, India

Bachelor of Engineering: Computer Science

WEBSITES, PORTFOLIOS, PROFILES

www.linkedin.com/in/dharshinisuresh

kumar

Ernest & Young - Senior Consultant Bengaluru 03/2021 - 05/2022

Involved in analyzing business

requirements and prepared detailed specifications that follow project guidelines required for project development

Developed Hive SQL queries,

Mappings, tables, external tables in Hive for analysis across different banners and worked on partitioning, optimization, compilation, and execution

● Wrote complex queries to get the

data into HBase and responsible for

executing hive queries using Hive Command Line

● Automated workflows using shell scripts to pull data from various data bases

into Hadoop

Wrote Hive jobs to parse the logs and structure them in tabular format to

facilitate effective querying on the log data

Implemented Spark using Scala/Python and Spark SQL for faster testing

and processing of data

Ascendum Solutions LLC - Senior Software Engineer Bengaluru 09/2019 - 03/2021

Developed reusable transformations to load data from Flat files and other

data sources to the Data Warehouse

Implemented Spark using Scala/Python and Spark SQL for faster testing

and processing of data

Used Spark Streaming to divide streaming data into batches as an input to

Spark engine for batch processing

Designed batch processing jobs using Apache Spark to increase speed

compared to that of MapReduce jobs

Wrote Spark applications for data validation, cleansing, transformation,

custom aggregation

Services

03/2018 - 09/2019

libraries and maintain the old frameworks in optimistic way Has been part of creating dashboards using Kibana and using Grafana (For GCP Services)
